title: coland interop: identifierQuery always returns matched:false (opaque fail-closed)
description:
Side: coland (by design; informational).

identifiers/query always answers matched:false with no mimi_uri, mapping_policy "opaque_fail_closed", no PSI. It also takes hashed identifier_commitment values rather than the -07 identifierQuery request. So discovery against coland can never succeed. Verified live: a did:key-signed query for sha256("mimi://mimid.reviewcommit.com/u/alice") returned {"matches":[{"identifier_commitment":"sha256:f811...","matched":false}],"has_more":false}.
Code: handlers.rs mimi_identifiers_query; arkret-spec mimi-interop.md §10.
